answers.workaround:
My current workrounds:

```gdscript
static func get_singletons()->Dictionary:
    var singletons: = {}
    var config: = ConfigFile.new()
    var err: = config.load("project.godot")
    if err:
        push_error("Error when loading project.godot")
        return singletons

    var autoload: = "autoload"
    if not config.has_section(autoload): return singletons

    for key in config.get_section_keys(autoload):
        var val:String = config.get_value(autoload, key)
        val = val.trim_prefix("*")
        singletons[key] = val
        
    return singletons
```
the above one works only if the project isn't changed/dirty


```gdscript
static func get_autoload_singletons()->Array:
    var autoload_prop_start = "autoload/"
    var singletons: = []
    for i in ProjectSettings.get_property_list():
        if i.name.begins_with(autoload_prop_start):
            singletons.push_back(i.name.trim_prefix(autoload_prop_start))
    return singletons
```
